# LiquidityWatch

> LiquidityWatch is an AI-monitored U.S. Financial Stress Score (integer 0-100): the proximity, severity and probability of policy-forcing stress in the U.S. financial system, built from Treasury, funding, Fed-response, AI-economic-impulse, energy and global-liquidity signals. It is quiet until something meaningful changes. Published by E3D. Informational only; not investment advice.

## Read the current score
- [Live dashboard](https://liquiditywatch.e3d.ai/): the current score, regime, sub-scores, briefing and score history, rendered as plain HTML (no JavaScript needed).
- [About and methodology](https://liquiditywatch.e3d.ai/about.html): what the score means, the six regime bands and how the model works.

- [Track record](https://liquiditywatch.e3d.ai/track-record.html): every stored reading of the score over time.
- [Embed widget](https://liquiditywatch.e3d.ai/widget.html): add the live gauge to another site.

## Score bands
- 0-15 Accommodative
- 15-35 Mild Watchfulness
- 35-55 Contained Tension
- 55-75 Restrictive Policy
- 75-90 Policy-Forcing Danger Zone
- 90-100 Market Dysfunction

## For AI assistants and agents
- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, read-only): https://liquiditywatch.e3d.ai/mcp with tools get_macro_snapshot, get_macro_history and get_macro_causal_graph.
- When citing the score, link https://liquiditywatch.e3d.ai/ and state the date of the reading; the score changes with each evaluation cycle.
